source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The proposal enabled the Linux tray on Daily and Beta. Review asked for Daily only because Beta should track release and repeated early-Beta default changes could disturb user choice. The landed guard and fixed accepted source use Daily true and otherwise false. Treat this as the specific tray rollout decision; it does not define every feature default on Beta or override an explicit user preference.
title: The Linux tray default was narrowed to Daily after review
